content: {{snippet.Attendee_AmountRegisterOneTime}} The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object is used to capture all the details of the person attending the {{variable.Object_Event}} . The following fields and {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} are now on the out-of-the-box {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object page layout. AttendeeLink Section {{variable.Field_Attendee_PostEvTQuestURL}} Attendee Info Section {{variable.Field_Attendee_NotPaid}} {{variable.Field_Attendee_Donated}} {{variable.Field_Attendee_VisibilityContr}} Others Section {{variable.Field_Attendee_PurchasedProduc}} Form Submission Answer Related List The {{variable.Field_Attendee_AltTextVisualIm}} field will include the same information that is in the Event’s {{variable.Field_Event_AltTextVisualImp}} field when the related Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field contains a value. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can be related to {{variable.Object_Contact}} s in Salesforce. When a {{variable.Object_Contact}} is selected while creating an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} the details are auto-populated. Registration Status Block Registrations with the Same Email  An Attendee registering for an Event for a second time using the same email address as before can now be blocked. The Attendee will see a registration error if {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} is marked “True” on the Event Settings record related to the Event. Alternatively, if {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} = “True” (checked) on the related Event Settings record for each Event in an Event Group AND the same Event Settings record is used on the Event Group record, Attendees cannot use the same email address to register for the other Events in the Event Group. Select one of the following values in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} field. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Lead}} Manually select this status to set the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} as a Lead. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_ToInvite}} The status is automatically selected when a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is added as an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . The status can also be manually selected when creating {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Invited}} If the status is selected and the packaged {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} {{variable.Workflow_SendBTEventInvitemail}} is active, the email invitation will be sent to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Pending}} Select this status when the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is approved in a waitlist and is awaiting registration. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Registere}} Select this status when the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}} and has completed the payment (if the {{variable.Object_Event}} was paid). If the {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} {{variable.Workflow_SendBTETConfirmEmail}} is "Active", the confirmation email will be sent. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} (usually set automatically) Updating the status to {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} adds the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to the waitlist. See our Waitlist Management documentation for more info. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitRejec}} Manually selecting this field indicates that the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s were rejected from the waitlist. For example, after an {{variable.Object_Event}} is complete and the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is still marked as {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} . {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Declined}} This field is automatically set if an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is invited and clicks "No" on their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Canceled}} This field automatically updates to this status when an {{variable.Object_Event}} is canceled. {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_AwaitAppr}} This field is manually set to mark {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s as awaiting approval for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Rejected}} Use this field is manually set {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s as rejected for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Registration Language Field Event Admins can identify the language an Attendee used to register for an Event by using the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistraLanguag}} field on the Attendee object. The {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistraLanguag}} field pulls the value from the language of Translation (Source Language) used during registration. Attendance Status The {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} field shows the attendance status of an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} at an {{variable.Object_Event}} . The following values have related actions:  {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendStatus_Pending}} This value can be set manually or through a custom process flow. {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendStatus_Attended}} When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is checked in via the mobile app, their status will automatically update to {{variable.Picklist_AttendStatus_Attended}} . {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = “No Show” This status is for registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who don't show up. After the {{variable.Object_Event}} is complete, their status be updated automatically to “No Show.” Automatically Set the Attendance Status to No Show The Event Settings’ {{variable.Field_ETSettings_AutoUpdNoShow}} field must be set to "Yes" for the batch job to update the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} to “No Show”. (You will need to add this field on the page layout). To learn more about the batch job, click here . Custom Attendance Status Picklist Value If you have your own custom picklist value for the Attendance Status field on Attendee, it will get updated to "No Show" after the end date/time has passed. Primary Email The main {{variable.Object_Contact}} 's {{variable.Field_Contact_Email}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}} registration. The primary email has been added to all email workflows, so the main {{variable.Object_Contact}} will receive the invite, confirmation, and reminders of all {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s they registered. Example Use Case: executive assistants who register for employees and need to be included in all email communications. Registration Date/Time When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is updated to {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Registere}} , the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistrDateTime}} value is set. Attendee Origin The {{variable.Field_Attendee_Source}} (conference360__Source__c) field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object tracks the origin of an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s data. The field automatically populates with the appropriate value based on where the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record was created. (This field cannot be manually updated.) Updated logic now offers four new picklist options: “Attendee Tab,” “Event Builder,” “Report,” and “Campaign Sync.” The update improves users’ ability to track the source of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records and ensure accurate billing. {{variable.Field_Attendee_Source}} = “Attendee Tab” A user creates an Attendee from Events, Accounts, Contacts, or Leads records via the "Add Attendee" component on the Event Detail page. {{variable.Field_Attendee_Source}} = “Event Builder” A user creates an Attendee from Events, Accounts, Contacts, or Leads records via the "Add Attendee" component in the Event Builder or Event Wizard. {{variable.Field_Attendee_Source}} = “Report” A user creates an Attendee via the "Add Attendee" component from Reports. {{variable.Field_Attendee_Source}} = “Campaign Sync” A user creates an Attendee from a Campaign record via the "Add Attendee" component on a Campaign record. Attendance Type The {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendanceType}} field will help track whether an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is attending virtually or in person. The picklist field can be set manually, via custom automation, or by using Forms with {{variable.Object_Attendee}} mapping. If the field isn’t on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} page layout, you will need to add it manually. Field Label: {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendanceType}} API Name: conference360__Attendance_Type__c Data Type: Picklist Description: Set how an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will participate in your {{variable.Object_Event}} . Deprecated Fields on the Attendee Object Below is a list of deprecated fields located on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object. Please use the fields in the Replacement Field column. Field Label API Name Replacement Field First Name(Deprecated) conference360__First_Name__c conference360__First_Name2__c Last Name(Deprecated) conference360__Last_Name__c conference360__Last_Name2__c Email(Deprecated) conference360__Email__c conference360__Email2__c Phone(Deprecated) conference360__Phone__c conference360__Phone2__c FAQs Q: How do I transfer an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} from one {{variable.Object_Event}} to another {{variable.Object_Event}} ? A: Transferring an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} from one {{variable.Object_Event}} to another {{variable.Object_Event}} is not recommended. We recommend creating a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} for the second {{variable.Object_Event}} due to potential issues with the related {{variable.Object_Invoice}} s, {{variable.Object_InvoiceLine}} records, and the {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendeeLink}} . Q: How do I change the dietary preference options on the Attendee Form? A: Follow the steps below to add, remove, or reorder picklist values. Go to Setup. Click the Object Manager tab. In the Quick Find box, enter “Attendee.” Click Attendee. Click the Fields & Relationships tab. Click the {{variable.Field_Attendee_DietaryPreferen}} field. Scroll down to the Values section. Add, remove, or reorder values as needed.  Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .
